title: Construction of the augmented full Cech module-sheaf complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ any set of indices in the same universe, $U:I\to\operatorname{Opens}(X)$ any family (not necessarily a cover), and $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf. Put $A=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $P(W)(V)=F(W\cap V)$, viewed as an $A$-module by restriction of scalars, with the evident restriction maps in both variables. Let $C^\bullet=\check C^\bullet(U,P)$ be the full unnormalized Cech complex, using categorical products of opens. There exist a cochain complex $D$ of $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaves in nonnegative degrees, a chain map $\epsilon:F[0]\to D$, and natural isomorphisms $e_p$ from the underlying presheaf of $A$-modules of $D^p$ to $C^p$. They satisfy $\operatorname{forget}(d_D^p)e_{p+1}=e_p d_C^p$. For every $y:\operatorname{Fin}(1)\to I$ and open $V$, the $y$-coordinate of $e_0\epsilon^0$ on sections over $V$ is the restriction $F(V)\to F((\prod_l U_{y(l)})\cap V)$. Finally, for every $p$, $D^p$ is isomorphic to $\prod_{y:\operatorname{Fin}(p+1)\to I}j_{y,*}(F|_{\bigcap_lU_{y(l)}})$, where $j_y:\bigcap_lU_{y(l)}\to X$ is the open immersion. No exactness or quasi-isomorphism is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the opposite-opens module-sheaf functor, its concrete full Cech complex D and its degree-zero restriction map a as in [def-pc-cech-module-sheaf-functor]. Naturality of restriction makes both degree-zero coface composites equal. Expanding the first differential as the difference of these two cofaces proves a followed by d^0 equals zero.

Apply [lem-pc-cech-module-sheaf-comparison] to obtain the degreewise section isomorphisms, differential compatibility and coordinates of a. Use CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv to extend the cocycle a to a chain map epsilon from F[0]. Its degree-zero component is a, by fromSingle₀Equiv_symm_apply_f_zero; singleObjXSelf is the identity in degree zero. This transfers the stated coordinate formula to epsilon. No object is chosen from an unproved theorem.

Apply [lem-pc-cech-module-sheaf-terms] in each degree to obtain the final family of term isomorphisms. Package D, epsilon, the comparisons and these three proved clauses into the requested existential.

theorem exists_augmented_cech_sheaf_complex
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (F : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (D : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ)
      (ε : (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).obj F ⟶ D)
      (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat)).X p),
      (∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1)) ∧
      (∀ (y : Fin 1 → ι) (V : X.Opens),
        ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 F).inv ≫ ε.f 0).val ≫
          (e 0).hom ≫
            Pi.π (fun y : Fin 1 → ι =>
              ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
                (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat).obj
                  (op (∏ᶜ fun l => U (y l)))) y).app (op V) =
          F.presheafModuleCat.map (prod.snd : (∏ᶜ fun l => U (y l)) ⨯ V ⟶ V).op) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, Nonempty (D.X p ≅ ∏ᶜ fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ι =>
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (⨅ l, U (y l)).ι).obj (F.restrict (⨅ l, U (y l)).ι)))
